name: Employment-Based Residence Status

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must register on the official work-permit platform (workpermit.am) and submit a description of the vacancy.
The Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs must confirm the position before the employer can sign a contract with the foreign candidate.

requirement_groups.name: EAEU citizens -- exempt from work permit

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of Eurasian Economic Union member states (Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan) are exempt from any work-permit-type document for the whole period of their employment contract, though they may register for a residence verification certificate.

evidence_required.document: Employer's online vacancy registration on workpermit.am
Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs confirmation

sources.title: Armenia's official online work-permit platform -- employer registration, vacancy description, Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs confirmation, employment contract, EAEU-citizen exemption, application fees (AMD 105,000 initial/extension)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). No labour-market test (e.g. a requirement to first advertise to Armenian nationals) or sectoral quota system was found described on the official platform reviewed -- disclosed as a possible gap in what was surfaced, not asserted as confirmed absent. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since status is tied to the specific employer/contract; a change of employer likely requires a new application, though this was not independently confirmed. citizenship_after_months and pr_after_months (36) reuse the general figures from am_permanent_residence.json and am_naturalisation.json.
